cases.description: Title, both arrow-labelled axes, all quadrant labels, four plotted quadrants, quoted comma-bearing label, classDef class styling, inline point styles, and diagram sizing directive.
cases.source:
```mermaid
%%{init: {"quadrantChart": {"chartWidth": 470, "chartHeight": 340, "pointRadius": 7}}}%%
quadrantChart
title Product priorities
x-axis Low reach --> High reach
y-axis Low effort --> High effort
quadrant-1 Scale
quadrant-2 Maintain
quadrant-3 Defer
quadrant-4 Explore

"Market, east":::featured: [0.82, 0.82]
Efficiency: [0.22, 0.76]
Retire: [0.18, 0.22]
Sustain: [0.76, 0.24]
Inline style: [0.61, 0.41] radius: 9,color:#c1121f,stroke-color:#111827,stroke-width:3px
classDef featured color:#123456,stroke-color:#31572c,stroke-width:2px,radius:8
```

cases.description: Minimal diagram with default dimensions and no axis text or point marks.
cases.source:
```mermaid
quadrantChart
title Default axes
quadrant-1 Upper right
quadrant-2 Upper left
quadrant-3 Lower left
quadrant-4 Lower right
```

cases.description: Out-of-range point value used to capture pinned parser failure output.
cases.source:
```mermaid
quadrantChart
title Out of range
Outside: [1.1, 0.5]
```

cases.description: Categorical x axis, numeric y range, titled bar and line plots.
cases.source:
```mermaid
xychart-beta
title "Weekly, signals"
x-axis "Day" [Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu]
y-axis "Index" 0 --> 100
bar "Visits" [20, 35, 53, 72]
line "Retention" [15, 49, 57, 84]
```

cases.description: Numeric axes, horizontal orientation, and both supported plot forms; config directive enables data labels.
cases.source:
```mermaid
%%{init: {"xyChart": {"width": 470, "height": 330, "showDataLabel": true}}}%%
xychart-beta horizontal
title "Latency by run"

y-axis "Milliseconds" 0 --> 100
bar [20, 44, 31, 79, 55]
```
